external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A grocery loyalty programme member who uses the mobile app and connects partner apps.

external_entities.name: member's phone
external_entities.description: A member's phone hosting the mobile app and its refresh token.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone.

external_entities.name: browser
external_entities.description: A browser used by members to sign in and approve partner app consent.
external_entities.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

external_entities.name: partner app
external_entities.description: A web application operated by another company, such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application used by members to sign in, call the rewards API, and disconnect partner apps.

processes.name: authorization server
processes.description: The server that signs members in, handles authorization code flows, issues tokens, and manages partner app consent.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

processes.name: rewards API
processes.description: The API called by the mobile app and partner apps to access the points ledger.
processes.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back

processes.name: support console
processes.description: A web application that closes a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

data_stores.name: identity database
data_stores.description: Stores member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: points ledger
data_stores.description: Stores every member's balance and every points transaction.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: Stores every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: use mobile app
data_flows.description: A member uses the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members use our mobile app.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: The mobile app signs a member in through the authorization server using the authorization code flow.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
data_flows.data_description: authorization request and authorization code flow data

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: The mobile app calls the rewards API with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back
data_flows.data_description: rewards API requests using an access token

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: The browser is used to sign in on the authorization server's sign-in page and approve consent.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser and approves a consent screen that lists the scopes.

data_flows.name: return code
data_flows.description: The browser returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.

data_flows.name: request tokens
data_flows.description: A partner app sends token requests containing its client secret in the request body.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.
data_flows.authentication: client ID and client secret in request body

data_flows.name: show points
data_flows.description: A partner app calls the rewards API to show a member's points.
data_flows.source_excerpt: such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points

data_flows.name: disconnect app
data_flows.description: The mobile app requests disconnection of a partner app from its settings screen.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members can disconnect a partner app from the settings screen of the mobile app

data_flows.name: manage identity
data_flows.description: The authorization server stores and deletes identity, token, authorization code, and consent records.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database, together with the authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents it issues.
data_flows.data_description: member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents

data_flows.name: issue mobile token
data_flows.description: The authorization server issues a mobile refresh token that is kept on the phone.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone.

data_flows.name: update ledger
data_flows.description: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger, including redemption changes.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

data_flows.name: write requests
data_flows.description: The rewards API writes every received request, including headers, to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.description: The support console marks a member's account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.

trust_boundaries.name: our cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud account in which the platform components and stores run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: member's phone
trust_boundaries.description: A member-controlled device outside the system's cloud account.

trust_boundaries.name: partner app server
trust_boundaries.description: A server operated by another company for its partner app.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The authorization server is reachable from external mobile apps, browsers, and partner servers, so it is internet-facing.
assumptions.basis: The description states that mobile apps, browsers, and partner servers connect to the authorization server.
The description states that the mobile app and partner apps call the rewards API.
The support console is served on a public hostname.

assumptions.assumption: The identity database contains confidential data because it stores member email addresses, password hashes, tokens, and consents.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents include personal information, credentials, secrets, and authorization records.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger contains confidential data because it stores every member's balance and points transactions.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents are member-specific loyalty and transaction records.
